single-file-total.cause: The total adds price and quantity instead of multiplying them.
single-file-total.impact: The cart reports an incorrect subtotal.

deleted-currency.cause: defaultCurrency.js is deleted while invoice.js still imports it.
deleted-currency.trigger: Load invoice.js as an ES module.
deleted-currency.consequence: Module resolution fails before formatInvoice can run.
deleted-currency.impact: Invoice formatters cannot load the module.

cross-file-settings.cause: The invoicePrefix setting becomes null, but the consumer assumes a string.
cross-file-settings.trigger: Load print.mjs with the shipped invoice.json in the working directory.
cross-file-settings.consequence: Calling toUpperCase on null aborts module initialization with a TypeError.
cross-file-settings.impact: The print module cannot load with the default invoice configuration.
